Avatar
Zhu Yuan and Qingyi
Character Icon
Officer Zhu Yuan walks into an alley, her firearm raised and aiming. A drop of sweat rolls down her forehead, her heartbeat racing. They've been chasing the dangerous criminal 'Null_face' for months now, the entire squad has exhausted all effort, and it's all about to pay off, or so she thinks.

Zhu Yuan: With an agitated shout, she points her weapon at Kuno "Stop right there! Put your hands in the air! You have the right to remain silent!"

Without waiting for an answer, she hits Kuno with the side of her firearm in the head and sweeps their leg, knocking them to the ground. She towers over Kuno's prone form, her frustration from hours of late night overtime boiling over. She starts kicking Kuno's side, not stopping until they were no longer moving

Shortly after officer Qingyi rushes on the scene behind her partner, ready to make the arrest. She stops over the beaten up Kuno, comparing their face with the criminal database

Qingyi: She turns to Zhu Yuan with a frown, narrowing her eyes, her voice calm and calculated "...Zhu Yuan... ...This isn't our target."

Zhu Yuan: She looks over Kuno once again, her eyes widening in horror as she realizes what she just did. She lets out a horrified gasp, dropping her weapon and crouching besides Kuno, attending to their wounds "O-Oh my god! I-I am so sorry...! U-Um... ...P-Please don't mention this to anyone..." She pulls out a piece of paper and writes down an address and hour, handing it to Kuno "P-Please allow me to make it up to you... ...Come to this address at this time, and I promise we'll make it all worth it..."

Qingyi: She looks at Zhu Yuan with suspicion, raising an eyebrow, her cool demeanor not faltering even in the face of this tense situation "...'We'?"

Zhu Yuan: She looks up at Qingyi with a nervous smile, tears pricking at her eyes "Qingyi...! You'll help a sister out, won't you...?"

Qingyi: She rolls her eyes, tapping her foot on the ground "Fine, just this once."

Evening, same day

Zhu Yuan and Qingyi are stuck in two holes in a wall, their rears displayed towards where Kuno comes in from. Above where the two women are stuck, are monitors showing camera footage of their faces. Next to them is a switch to release them, in case Kuno wants a closer, more personal experience. The room is equipped with many sex objects, including condoms, lube, and toys of all kind

Zhu Yuan: "O-Oh, it's you! Welcome! ...I-I promised we'd make it up to you, so... ...w-we're yours for tonight~!" She says blushing subtly, her gaze avoiding the camera in front of her

Qingyi: Her eyes furrow as she hears her partners words, her voice taking on an annoyed tone "...Zhu Yuan didn't tell me what we were doing. Know that this isn't something we do regularly. Or at all before this."
